tasks.name: Guest RFP Creation
tasks.description: Create a Guest RFP on Cvent for one venue (headless browser). Posts the result to Slack; confirmations are asked in Slack before submitting.

params.description: Exact venue title as shown on Cvent. Several venues for one RFP: separate them with |.
Optional. Slack channel for the confirmations. Defaults to the RFP channel.
Optional. Slack user ID (U...) of the person who asked for this RFP; named in the result message.
Optional. Slack user ID (U...) allowed to answer yes/no. Blank = any human in the channel.
